name: autocorrelation
description: Spatial autocorrelation of detection and abundance along each replicon and the origin-to-terminus gradient (GIPPA_SPEC.md §9.3, §7.3.5(c) and §7.3.5(e)).

fields.name: lag
fields.description: Lag in genes; NA for the descriptive oriter_slope rows

fields.name: null_model
fields.description: Null the row is tested against; bootstrap means a descriptive row with a bootstrap CI and no p-value

fields.name: value
fields.description: Reported statistic (Moran's I, the raw BB join count, or the OLS slope in log2 per replichore); NA when it does not exist

fields.name: null_mean
fields.description: Mean of the null distribution of the test statistic

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Name of the test statistic of the row

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Effect estimate: observed minus null mean, or the OLS slope

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval; NA when unestimated

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval; NA when unestimated

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: Permutation p-value; NA for a descriptive or not-estimable row

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: Benjamini-Hochberg q-value within (contig, statistic, null_model); NA whenever p_value is NA

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Valid permutations or bootstrap replicates behind the row

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined flags from the controlled vocabulary (§9.4)
